scope: structural agent, skill, routing, state, safety, and QA capabilities only

contracts.description: Brand capabilities are represented by independently routable skills.
A dedicated website builder skill exists.
Website fixture evaluates its CTA experiment on the server.
Browser accessibility and responsive checks are CI-configured.
Brand workspaces expose explicit state commands.
Artifact promotion fails closed on destination conflicts.
FAL outputs are downloaded and validated into URL-free local records.
Unknown evidence IDs are rejected instead of silently discarded.

limitations: This benchmark measures repository contracts, not LLM judgment, subjective design quality, or real-world business outcomes. The embedded baseline is used only when shallow clones do not contain baseline_ref.
